verdict.rationale: ClickUp documents an official MCP server that lets external AI agents work with Workspace data, including tasks, lists, folders and docs. The docs include a published tool list (e.g. Search Workspace, time tracking) and a Claude setup guide, and a probe confirmed the official MCP documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect your AI with ClickUp using our MCP Server.
The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is a secure, standardized framework that lets external AI agents interact with ClickUp Workspace data—like tasks, lists, folders, and docs—using natural language.
Set up Claude to use the ClickUp MCP server!
Search Workspace | Searches for items across the entire ClickUp Workspace, including tasks, Lists, Folders, and Docs.
